title: Full Functional Restoration — Quantumoney Core Rebuild (Frontend)

requirements.summary: Remove all animated coin visuals, 3D decorative elements, and unnecessary visual overlays from all pages
acceptanceCriteria: No animated coin images appear on any page
No Three.js / React Three Fiber components render
SpaceBackground is removed from Layout
Pages load without any CSS or JS animation classes on decorative elements

file_operations.description: Remove SpaceBackground component from Layout wrapper. Keep Header, main content area, Footer, and CookieConsentBanner only.
Delete the CSS-animated space background component with stars, comets, meteorites, and planets.
Delete the Three.js React component rendering animated 3D gold QMY coins.
Delete the placeholder Three.js scene component.
Remove space background, animated floating coin bursts, and any FloatingQMYCoins or Three.js Canvas components. Keep hero section with logo and tagline, and feature grid only.
Remove React Three Fiber Canvas and 3D coin rendering logic. Keep only the device camera, geolocation, and backend map markers integration for future map-based implementation.
Remove or disable all CSS animation classes (@keyframes) related to decorative elements (floating, drifting, glow effects). Keep only essential layout and theme styling.

requirements.summary: Fix all page titles where the string 'nav.' appears as a prefix
acceptanceCriteria: No visible heading or tab label contains the prefix 'nav.'
All page titles render as readable text

file_operations.description: Audit all translation keys in the Portuguese and English dictionaries. Replace any keys prefixed with 'nav.' (e.g., 'nav.map', 'nav.profile') with clean, human-readable titles like 'Map', 'Profile', 'Mapa', 'Perfil'.
Review tab labels and ensure they use translation keys without 'nav.' prefix. Update to use clean translation keys for Home, Map, AR, Profile, DAO, Banco, Chat.
Review desktop nav links and mobile menu items. Replace any 'nav.' prefixed translation keys with clean titles.
Ensure page heading uses a clean title like 'Map' or 'Mapa' without 'nav.' prefix from translations.

requirements.summary: Restore a fixed footer across all pages displaying exactly: '© 2026 Quantumoney. All rights reserved.' and 'By HTgamers'
acceptanceCriteria: Footer is fixed at the bottom on all pages
Footer text reads '© 2026 Quantumoney. All rights reserved.' and 'By HTgamers'
No page or footer contains the word 'Caffeine'

file_operations.description: Update Footer component to display exactly '© 2026 Quantumoney. All rights reserved.' and 'By HTgamers' with gold styling. Remove any reference to 'Caffeine'.
Ensure Footer is rendered in Layout and positioned fixed at the bottom across all pages.
Search for and remove any 'Caffeine' references in page content.
Search for and remove any 'Caffeine' references in page content.
Search for and remove any 'Caffeine' references in page content.

requirements.summary: Enforce a clean, simple dark layout with yellow/gold accent details across the entire app
acceptanceCriteria: All pages use a dark background (#0a0a0a or equivalent)
Accent color is yellow/gold throughout
No animated or 3D background is present
UI is legible and consistent across all routes

file_operations.description: Set global body background to #0a0a0a or equivalent dark color. Ensure all CSS custom properties use yellow/gold accent colors. Remove gradient and glow effect classes.
Verify and enforce the custom color palette uses dark backgrounds and yellow/gold accents (gold-50 through gold-950). Remove any gradient configurations.
Ensure Layout wrapper applies dark background color class to the main content area.
Verify Container applies consistent dark theming and does not introduce conflicting backgrounds.

requirements.summary: Restore Internet Identity login as the sole authentication method
acceptanceCriteria: Login button triggers Internet Identity authentication popup
After successful login, the user's Principal ID is accessible in AuthContext
Logout clears the session
Unauthenticated users are redirected or shown a login prompt on protected pages

file_operations.description: Verify LoginButton correctly triggers Internet Identity login via useAuth hook and displays login/logout state with spinner. Remove profile error display until profile system is fully restored.

Ensure AuthContext correctly exposes principal ID, login status flags, and wraps useInternetIdentity login/logout logic. Verify the authorization component is used to initialize access control on login.
Verify Internet Identity authentication using @dfinity/auth-client works end-to-end, with login opening II popup and identity state persisting after success.
Ensure ProfilePage requires authentication and redirects or shows a login prompt if the user is not authenticated.
Ensure Perfil page requires authentication and shows a login prompt if the user is not authenticated.

requirements.summary: Restore the /profile page to display: the user's Principal ID, QMY balance, ICP balance, and current XP
acceptanceCriteria: /profile shows Principal ID for authenticated users
QMY balance is fetched from canister 5o54h-giaaa-aaaad-aentq-cai and displayed
ICP balance is displayed
XP is displayed
All values show '0' if the balance fetch returns empty or zero — the wallet section is always visible

file_operations.description: Display the authenticated user's Principal ID using useInternetIdentity. Fetch QMY balance via useQMYLedger hook from canister 5o54h-giaaa-aaaad-aentq-cai, ICP balance via useICPLedger, and XP from backend profile via useProfile. Always show the wallet section even if balances are zero.
Verify useQMYLedger hook fetches QMY balance from the correct canister ID (5o54h-giaaa-aaaad-aentq-cai) using ICRCLedgerClient and returns 0 if balance is unavailable.
Verify useICPLedger hook fetches ICP balance using ICPLedgerClient and returns 0 if balance is unavailable.
Verify useProfile hook fetches the current user's PlayerProfile including XP field from backend actor via getCallerUserProfile and handles null/missing profile gracefully.
Ensure ARCoinBalance card always displays the wallet section with available, locked, and bonus token categories showing 0 if no data is available.
Verify ICRCLedgerClient uses canister ID 5o54h-giaaa-aaaad-aentq-cai for QMY ledger queries.

requirements.summary: On the frontend, after a successful first login, call the welcome bonus endpoint and display a banner/modal showing '+1000 QMY and +100 XP received'
acceptanceCriteria: Welcome bonus banner/modal appears on first login
It shows +1000 QMY and +100 XP
It does not appear on subsequent logins
It can be dismissed by the user

file_operations.description: Update WelcomeBonusBanner component to display +1000 QMY and +100 XP amounts with a close/dismiss button. Ensure it renders as a full-screen modal.

After successful first login, call the backend claimWelcomeBonus endpoint and set a flag/state to trigger WelcomeBonusBanner display. Store a flag in localStorage to prevent showing the banner on subsequent logins.
Conditionally render WelcomeBonusBanner in Layout based on AuthContext state (first login flag).
Add a hook or mutation to call backend claimWelcomeBonus endpoint and handle the response (QMY and XP amounts).

requirements.summary: Restore the /map page with a fully functional Leaflet + OpenStreetMap 2D map
acceptanceCriteria: Leaflet map renders on /map
OpenStreetMap tiles load
Coin markers appear at their real-world coordinates
Map loads without console errors

file_operations.description: Ensure MapPage renders a Leaflet map with OpenStreetMap tiles. Fetch coin locations from backend via useMapMarkers hook and display them as markers with custom SVG icons at their real geographic coordinates. Verify map initializes without errors.
Verify useMapMarkers hook fetches map markers from backend actor via getMapMarkers with 30-second polling and 15-second stale time.
Ensure Leaflet CSS and JS are loaded via CDN in the HTML entry point.
Provide fallback static map markers if backend data is unavailable during initial development.

requirements.summary: Implement the basic coin capture mechanic on the map
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a coin marker within 50m triggers a capture call to the backend
QMY balance increases after a successful capture
XP increases proportionally to distance
Clicking a marker more than 50m away shows 'Too far to capture' message
Captured coins are removed or marked as taken on the map

file_operations.description: Add click handlers to coin markers that: 1) Get user's current device location via useSharedLocation hook, 2) Calculate distance to coin using the distance utility, 3) If within 50m, call a backend capture endpoint (to be added in backend plan), 4) If >50m, show 'Too far to capture' toast/message, 5) On success, remove or mark the marker as captured and refresh balances.
Verify useSharedLocation hook watches the device's geolocation and returns current position, loading state, and errors.
Verify the Haversine distance calculation function returns distance in meters between two lat/lon coordinates.
Add a mutation hook to call a backend coin capture endpoint (captureCoin or similar) that accepts coin ID and user location, returning updated QMY balance and XP.
Add logic to invalidate or refetch map markers after a successful coin capture to reflect the updated state.

requirements.summary: Temporarily disable or hide the following features from the UI and routing: Advanced Central Bank dashboard, DAO voting and proposals, complex vesting schedules, public token burns, and all charts/graphs
acceptanceCriteria: DAO pages are not accessible from main navigation
Central Bank advanced page is not accessible from main navigation
Complex vesting pages are not accessible from main navigation
Public burn pages are not accessible from main navigation

Bottom navigation only shows: Home, Map, Profile

file_operations.description: Remove tabs for DAO, Banco (Central Bank), AR, and Chat from the bottom navigation bar. Keep only Home, Map, and Profile tabs visible.
Remove or comment out navigation links to DAO, Central Bank, AR, Chat, Vesting, Burn, and Chart pages from the desktop nav and mobile menu.

Comment out or remove route registrations for DAO pages (DAOPage, DAOProposalDetailPage, DAOCreateProposalPage), Central Bank (BancoCentral), Vesting (VestingQTM, VestingDeflationPage), Burn (QueimaDeflacao), and any chart/graph pages.
Add a 'Coming Soon' placeholder message to the Central Bank page or prevent navigation to it entirely.
Replace page content with a 'Coming Soon' placeholder message.
Replace page content with a 'Coming Soon' placeholder message.
Prevent this chart component from rendering on any page by removing its usage or conditionally hiding it.
Prevent this chart component from rendering on any page by removing its usage or conditionally hiding it.

requirements.summary: Simplify the bottom navigation bar to show only the core active tabs: Home, Map, and Profile
acceptanceCriteria: Bottom nav has exactly 3 tabs: Home, Map, Profile
Removed tabs do not appear
Active tab is highlighted in yellow/gold

file_operations.description: Reduce the bottom navigation to exactly 3 tabs: Home, Map, and Profile. Remove AR, DAO, Banco, and Chat tabs. Ensure the active tab is highlighted with yellow/gold accent color.

requirements.summary: Restore a basic transaction history display on /profile showing the user's recent QMY coin captures
acceptanceCriteria: Transaction/capture history section is visible on /profile
Each entry shows date, QMY received, and XP gained
Empty state message is shown when no history exists

file_operations.description: Add a transaction history section that displays recent QMY coin captures. Fetch capture history from backend (via a new query hook) and render each entry with date, QMY amount, and XP gained. Show 'No captures yet' empty state message when history is empty. Always display the section.
Add a query hook to fetch the user's capture/transaction history from backend actor (e.g., getCaptureHistory endpoint to be added in backend plan).
Update QMYTransactionHistory component to display capture history entries with date, QMY received, XP gained, and handle loading/error/empty states. Always render the section.
